author: kedhareswer
name: 3D Journal Page Carousel
description: 3D journal page carousel: an open scrapbook spread in the middle with earlier and later pages standing edge-on in two receding stacks. Drag, flick, click a page or use the arrow keys to turn; each turn swings the next spread in and folds the last one shut. Polaroids, taped prints and handwritten notes sit on each page, and it auto-advances until touched.
